title: Progress of Jurong Region MRT Line Development
what_it_is: Progress of Jurong Region MRT Line Development

sections.label: Jurong Region MRT Line progress
sections.summary: The JRL will open in phases between 2027 and 2029, with more details in early 2026 after a civil works milestone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport (a) what is the latest progress on the Jurong Region MRT Line (JRL); (b) when is the earliest possible date for Phase 1 of the JRL to be operational.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We had previously announced that the JRL will open in phases between 2027 and 2029.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We will share more details in early 2026 after we reach an important milestone in completion of further civil works on the JRL.

sections.label: Jurong bus services by LTA
sections.summary: LTA provides bus services connecting Jurong residents to transport nodes and amenities, improving and adding services under the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: At this present moment, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has provided bus services to connect residents to transport nodes and amenities across Jurong region, which includes Nanyang Division.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Through the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme, LTA has been improving existing services and introducing new bus services, especially for residents in new estates that are further from existing transport nodes.

sections.label: Gek Poh MRT bus planning
sections.summary: A Member asks whether a new bus service from Jurong West Streets 91 and 93 to Gek Poh MRT station can be planned now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: My point is that there is no direct bus service now connecting the residents from Jurong West Streets 91 and 93, to the upcoming Gek Poh MRT station.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: So, when we asked LTA whether they will plan for the new bus service, they said they will wait for the new MRT station to be ready; they will plan for it then.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: So, my point is that, can we plan for it now, so that the new bus service can be ready, in tandem with opening of the JRL Gek Poh station.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: It was mentioned by the hon Member the Gek Poh MRT station was not completed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: So, we really, at the end of the day, plan bus routes in relation to expressed needs and there is a balance to be struck.
